slug: 玄幻苟在深山打猎开局弟妹上门求肉
lines: “大哥，你之前打的肉呢？”
“爹娘可是说了，你弟弟要考科举，咱家的肉都得可着他吃，耽误了的话，你可担待不起。”
“你怎么才打到一只兔子啊？”
“真是的，就这么点肉，真是没用！”
没用？
肉？
破草席上，王大山迷迷糊糊睁开了眼睛，一个诱人的背影，出现在了他的视线之中。
有些破旧的补丁布衣，暴露出一片片雪白。
“咕咚！”
看清身影之后，他忍不住咽了咽口水！
“也不知道，哪里来的小娘们，不对，我不是在打螺丝么？怎么会出现在这里？”
王大山猛地坐了起来，眼底透着几分震惊！
他掐了一下自己，确定不是做梦之后，顿时激动了起来。
他才刚刚当牛做马，背上房贷，买了房子，转眼就给他干到了这个古代世界，成了一个破落户。
问题是这个世界还处于饥荒年，王朝末世。
“你有没有听我说话？肉我先拿走了。”
王大山顺着视线看了过去，顿时忍不住皱眉。
一个二十上下，肤若凝脂的美艳女子，正不耐烦的瞪着他！
本来惊艳的面孔上，却透着几分刻薄，让人忍不住生厌。
“都拿走？你们哪来的脸，拿走了我吃什么？”
王大山忍不住暗暗冷笑，关于女子的记忆，一下就涌上了心头。
原身在家中地位极低，一直都是当牛做马的角色。
一直到最近，眼前这个女人。
他的未婚妻上门借住之后，地位直接一落千丈。
偏心爹娘不仅强行让他把未婚妻让给弟弟。
这女人也跟弟弟勾勾搭搭的。
但凡有什么好的东西，都第一时间被这吸血鬼家人拿走了。
短短三年的时间，原身壮硕的身材，都快饿成了皮包骨！
前不久父母上门，一起搬空了原身的米缸，说什么弟弟要准备赶考，将家里的米粮，全都拿去换了盘缠。
没有办法，原身只能冒险在大冬天的进山讨食。
要知道，进山意就意味着把脑袋拴在裤腰上了。
不光要面对饿急眼的凶恶野兽，还要面对出没的妖魔，普通人当猎户，就是在拿小命去拼。
content_en:
"Brother, where is the meat you beat before?"
"My parents have said that your brother is going to take the imperial examination, and all our meat must be available to him. If there is a delay, you can't afford it."
"How did you catch a rabbit?"
"Really, just this little meat is really useless!"
Useless?
Meat?
On the broken straw mat, Wang Dashan opened his eyes in a daze, and a seductive figure from behind appeared in his sight.
Some shabby patched cloth clothes revealed patches of snowy white.
"Gudong!"
After seeing the figure clearly, he couldn't help but swallowed!
"I don't know, where did this little girl come from? No, wasn't I driving screws? Why did she appear here?"
Wang Dashan sat up suddenly, with a bit of shock in his eyes!
After he pinched himself to make sure it was not a dream, he suddenly became excited.
He had just been working as a cow, taking on a mortgage, and bought a house. In the blink of an eye, he was in this ancient world and had become a shabby settlement.
The problem is that the world is still in the year of famine and the end of the dynasty.
"Did you listen to me? I'll take the meat first."
"Yeah."
Wang Dashan looked over and couldn't help but frown.
A beautiful woman in her twenties, with skin as thick as gelatin, was staring at him impatiently!
There was a hint of meanness in his originally stunning face, which made people irritated.
"Take them all away? Where do you have the face? What can I eat if you take them away?"
Wang Dashan couldn't help but sneer secretly, and the memory of the woman suddenly came to his mind.
Originally, my status in the family was very low, and I had always been a cow and a horse.
Until recently, this woman in front of me.
After his fiancée came to live with him, his status plummeted.
His eccentric parents not only forced him to give up his fiancée to his younger brother.
This woman also hooked up with her brother.
Whatever good things were there were immediately taken away by the vampire family.
In just three years, the original strong figure was reduced to skin and bones due to hunger!
Not long ago, my parents came to the house and emptied the original rice vat together. They said that my younger brother was preparing to take the exam, so they took all the rice in the house in exchange for expenses.
There was no choice but to risk going into the mountains to beg for food in the dead of winter.
You know, going into the mountains means tying your head to your waistband.
Not only do they have to face hungry and ferocious beasts, but they also have to face haunted demons. When ordinary people become hunters, they are risking their lives.
